card.name: Small words before an upcoming verb or noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words (are, the, be, to, if, in) and words like trouble or difficulty, placed just before a verb-ing or process word such as blowing, drawn, hearing, swallowing or distribution.

modes.label: Linking word before an action
modes.description: A small word like are, be, to, if or the sits right before a verb describing air, gas or drug movement.
modes.example: you can breathe through pursed lips (as if you<< are>> blowing out a candle)

modes.label: Trouble or difficulty before a function
modes.description: Words like trouble, difficulty or decreased come just before a body function such as hearing or swallowing.
modes.example: Call your doctor if you or your older child complains of an earache or has<< trouble>> hearing.
